privacy.title: Privacy-friendly start
privacy.body: This app sets no cookies. It loads no analytics, remote fonts, or external connectors and only stores the local data described in Settings.

about.title: About Foldmark
about.description: Foldmark is a local-first editor for letters, postcards and cards: write once, print onto different sheets — with fold and punch marks in millimetres, without an account and without a server.
about.privacyBody: Foldmark works without an account and without a server. All data stays in this browser; the privacy view shows what is stored and deletes it on request.
about.librariesBody: Foldmark is built on free software. The list shows every library with its version, licence and project page.

intro.welcomeBody: Foldmark writes letters, postcards and cards once and prints them onto different sheets — with fold and punch marks in millimetres. Three short steps show what the app does.
intro.settingsBody: Both can be changed at any time in the settings, and are stored in this browser only.

privacyPanel.title: Privacy and data
privacyPanel.localTitle: Your data stays in this browser
privacyPanel.localBody: The application stores its content in IndexedDB and its preferences in this browser’s local storage. There is no account, no server and no background transfer. What you delete here is gone.
privacyPanel.deleteDataHint: Clears all content. Your preferences are kept.
privacyPanel.resetSettingsHint: Language, appearance and every other preference back to its default. Your content is kept.
privacyPanel.resetConfirmText: Every preference returns to its default. Your content is kept.
privacyPanel.inventoryHint: These numbers are counted from local storage every time this view opens.
privacyPanel.backupHint: A backup contains everything: documents, addresses, senders, your own profiles, images and settings.

calibration.title: Calibration sheet
calibration.description: Prints known distances on this paper so you can measure your printer’s offset and scale with a ruler.
calibration.instructions:
1. Print this sheet at **100 %** — no “fit to page”, no scaling.

2. Measure from each paper edge to the frame: it should be **{inset} mm** on every side. A difference is your printer’s offset on that side.

3. Measure the frame itself: it should be **{width} × {height} mm**. A difference is a scale error; check the printer’s scaling setting.

4. The ticks along the frame are 10 mm apart, longer every 50 mm. The cross marks the centre of the sheet.
